description: Reza Bahadori and colleagues at ZHAW publish an Excel tool for selecting district-heating modernisation strategies. The April 2026 workbook is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0 and links to the Energies paper describing its literature review, expert interviews and portfolio analysis. Strategies include reduced operating temperatures, improved substations, renewable or waste heat, storage and expanded monitoring. Coverage is a user-defined heating network, not an observed national dataset. The workbook can structure retrofit scenarios before detailed infrastructure simulations, but it is not documented as a hydraulic or dynamic thermal solver. Local inputs and stakeholder judgments influence the recommended strategy; scoring uncertainty and transferability were not independently assessed. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. Formulas, software compatibility and reported benefits were not checked because the workbook was not downloaded.
